\chapter{The Fourth Form Line: Work}
\label{ch:pa-form-work}
\hlchaptermodality{21}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can select between two separately practised values and fill one requested Gurmukhi work line from a nonverbal cue with no model.}

The learner fills one work field from a nonverbal cue after selection, supported entry, spelling, spacing, field-value agreement, delayed entry, and repair have each received a bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[two work-value cues]{Select one known work value}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-select}



\begin{quote}
Read the closed practice bank once:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — attach one cue to each value}
Point to A, then \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}. Point to B, then \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}. Cover the bank and say which value B requests. Selection is separate from spelling.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal, point, cover, and select once more. Do not write the form line yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
These cues belong only to this invented two-item bank.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field]{Fill one supported work field}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep this invented bank visible:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — model visible}
Complete \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for A. Read the label, select the A value, and copy it. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Compare selection, spelling, spacing, field-value agreement, and placement in separate passes.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one supported line.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work-value spelling]{Check only the work-value spelling}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-spelling}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} and \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} once. Touch each script piece without writing a form line.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one spelling pass}
Cover both models and write \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} once. Reveal it and compare \textbf{\pa{ਨੌ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਕ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਰੀ}}. Ignore the field label and spacing today.

\subsection*{Your turn}
If a piece differs, rewrite only that piece before copying the whole value once more.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Selection and spacing are not scored in this pass.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field spacing]{Give the work value its own space}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-spacing}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}. Point once to the label and once to the value.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one spacing pass}
Copy \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}:}, leave a clear space, then copy \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}. Judge only the boundary after the colon.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Cover the model and repeat once. If the boundary is unclear, repair only the space.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Selection, spelling, and agreement are not scored in this spacing pass.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field and value agreement]{Keep the field and value together}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-agreement}



\begin{quote}
Read \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}}, then \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}} and \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}. Both values answer the work label in this closed bank.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one agreement pass}
Choose the line whose value agrees with the work label: \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} or \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਸ਼ਹਿਰ}}. Copy only the agreeing line. This checks field-value meaning, not grammatical gender.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the label, say “work,” then point to the chosen value and say its meaning. Ignore handwriting neatness.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This pass separates field-value meaning from spelling and spacing.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field after a short delay]{Hide, wait, then fill the work field}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Read A — \textbf{\pa{ਖੇਤੀ}}, B — \textbf{\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} once. Hide the bank and count slowly to ten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — short delayed entry}
With the bank hidden, complete \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for B. Finish the attempt before revealing the bank.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal and compare selection, spelling, spacing, agreement, then placement. Do not repair yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One delayed line is enough.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field repair]{Repair one work-field difference}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-repair}



\begin{quote}
Compare \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}:\pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}} with \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \pa{ਨੌਕਰੀ}}. The selection, letters, and field-value meaning match; one boundary differs.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — one repair pass}
Rewrite the first line with a clear space after the colon. Leave every letter unchanged.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Name the repaired dimension: selection, spelling, spacing, agreement, or placement. Stop after one repair.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The next lesson asks for a fresh line rather than a repair.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[work field]{One no-model work field}

\label{lesson:PA-W05-work-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close the previous lesson. There is no value bank, support-language label, or romanized answer below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the requested field:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਕੰਮ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the known value attached to A and write it from memory. Do not reopen an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare selection, spelling, spacing, agreement, and placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This closes only the work-field ladder. The remaining form fields are separate backlog work.
\end{tcolorbox}
